blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The nutrition and dietetics (ND) regulatory board and several other health organizations called on Congress to push for institutionalized nutrition care in public and private hospitals nationwide. The group emphasized the need for a standardized Nutrition Care Process (NCP) in hospital management in hospitals across the country through the passage of House Bill No. 3806 and Senate Bill No. 1213, also known as the proposed “Wastong Nutrisyon sa Ospital Act,” The measures seek to institutionalize NCP as a mandatory component for inpatient and outpatient care in all public and private healthcare facilities.
